name: Centurion AFV
description: Centurion Tank: At the end of World War II, the British developed the Centurion tank as their primary station tank. Although 6 prototypes were sent to the European battlefield before the end of the war, they did not catch up with any battles. After the war, the Centurion tank continued to be produced and in service with the British Royal Army. Due to its excellent design, it has been favored by other countries and has become the tank with the most service in Western countries after World War II. It is also the tank design that has been in service for the longest time.
